title: Rustic Renaissance
description: Rustic is a medieval expansion mod. Now for 1.20.1!
body:
Rustic Renaissance
Rustic Renaissance is small-ish mod that mainly adds medieval-themed content to the game. It focuses on decoration and agriculture for now, but it branches out a bit as well.

This Mod is for 1.20.1 check out the [Original](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/rustic)!

For a full list of features, check out the wiki!
If you want to know what kinds of features this mod has without reading a wiki, here's a brief summary of the main features:

Bees
An new alchemy system
A few crops
A brewing system for making alcoholic beverages with unique and actually useful effects
Some new trees
Plenty of decorative blocks
An in-game guidebook to explain everything the mod has to offer
THIS IS A VERY EXPERIMENTAL VERSION EXPECT BUGS
